description: Scaffolds the plugin that carries other components — the directory tree, a valid `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, the marketplace entry, and `claude plugin validate --strict` until it passes. Use when the plugin itself is the artifact: starting one, deciding which surfaces it must reach, adding a component directory, or fixing a plugin whose components are not loading and the manifest or layout is suspected. Do not use to write the components themselves — skill-creator, agent-creator, hook-creator, mcp-creator and command-creator each own their own artifact, and this skill hands off to them. Do not use to review an existing component's quality: the five reviewer agents do that read-only.
